description: OpenClaw plugin for safe X/Twitter workflows powered by TwexAPI.
rules: Use the explore tool before xapiclaw to find supported TwexAPI endpoints.
Use the highest available TwexAPI endpoint version when duplicate capabilities exist.
Never expose TwexAPI API keys, cookies, auth tokens, or bearer tokens.
Require explicit approval before write, private-read, paid-bulk, DM, Grok, or account-affecting calls.
